name: Grupo SATA (SATA Holding)
note: Azores airline group: SATA Holding controls the operating subsidiaries SATA Air Açores, Azores Airlines and SGA (European Commission press release approving restructuring aid, 7 June 2022), and the SATA Group is 'ultimately controlled by the Portuguese Autonomous Region of Azores' (same release). Azores Airlines' own site (/news, September 2026) confirms the privatisation of SATA Internacional – Azores Airlines, a sale of at least 75%, was running then; no completed sale reported as of 3 October 2026.
